Since his arrival in the State Senate in 2018, Senator Tom Umberg has chaired the Senate Elections Committee and the Senate Judiciary Committee.
Senator Thomas J. Umberg is a California State Senator, representing District 34 which includes north central Orange County and Long Beach. He assumed office in 2018.

items.office: Deputy Drug Czar for President Bill Clinton

citations.quote: Senator Umberg served as Deputy Drug Czar for President Bill Clinton where he was responsible for foreign drug interdiction, counter-drug intelligence, and international drug policy.
